p: known of it: By which it is commanded to bear witness to the truth, and disclose the iniquity of the ungodly.
swear: Or, vow rashly without just examination of the circumstances, and not knowing what shall be the issue of the same.
things: Which have been mentioned before in this chapter.
make an atonement for him for: Or, declare him to be purged of that sin.
ephah of fine flour for a: Which was about a half gallon.
oil upon it: As in the meat offering, Le 2:1.
in the holy things of the: Concerning the first fruits or tithes, due to the priests and Levites.
with thy estimation by shekels of: By the estimation of the priest, Le 27:12.
bear his iniquity: That is, remembers after that he has sinned when his conscience accuses him.
ignorance wherein he erred and wist: Else if his sin against God come of malice, he must die; Nu 15:30.
